Hannah Brooks: quick check-in: shipping timeline from vendors updated today. H200 SKUs confirmed for July 7 GA window but H100 stock is limited. want to decide whether to gate H100 behind reserved capacity.
Ravi Kapoor: if H100 limited, we should still list H200 + B200 and mark H100 as "pre-order". partners ok with that?
Matsuo Saito: pushed to vendor; Nvidia marketing prefers combined announcement but supply risk is understood.
Karen Li: for marketplace images, we need exact kernel+driver pairs. Ops needs to validate images before public listing.
Hannah Brooks: action: Ravi to draft pre-order copy; Matsuo to confirm Nvidia preference; Karen to schedule image validation run next week.
OpsBot: reminder set for 2026-07-05 10:00 PT to run image validation (creator: Karen Li)
Ravi Kapoor: drafting pre-order copy now, will share in #marketing-review.
